_readme: Path rules for scripts/ci/risk-class.cjs (task N3-B1, owner policy r31). ADVISORY: the risk-class workflow only prints a class.

Per file the FIRST rule that matches, top to bottom, decides; the PR class is the HIGHEST class among its files. Order is therefore load-bearing: self-protection first, then the tests carve-out, then the MAJOR structure, then docs, then keywords.

Matchers: globs (** crosses directories, * does not, case-insensitive, anchored at the repo root); substrings (lowercased path contains it); tokens (a whole word of the path after splitting on non-alphanumerics and camelCase).
Anything no rule matches gets defaultClass (never LOW): unknown means one level up from what it looks like.
This file, the script and the workflow are MAJOR (rule 1). The workflow reads the BASE branch copy of all three, so a PR cannot lower its own class by editing them.
defaultReason: no rule matched: unknown paths go one level up from LOW, never LOW

packageJson.majorReason: package.json release fields changed (version/private/publishConfig/prepublishOnly): npm publish and release tags
packageJson.unknownReason: package.json changed and the release fields could not be compared: unsure goes up
packageJson.otherReason: package.json changed, release fields untouched (dependency or script change)

rules.reason: self-protection: the classifier's own rules, script or workflow; a PR must not lower its own class
CI authority: code owners, deploy and release/publish workflows
agent permission model: Claude settings and hooks
prod schema, DDL, grants and contracts
Railway/Vercel/Fly/Docker/env/deploy topology and package registry config
license text: legal and irreversible once public
RepID scoring, weights, rewards, billing, kernel, auth, identity, chain config and proof code (whole directories)
publishable package manifest: npm publish and release tags
answer-key is an eval answer key, not a credential: ordinary code, not a key/secret path
public-claim surface: narrowing a claim is LOW, a new claim is MAJOR, a path cannot tell, so one level up from docs
agent instructions (CLAUDE.md, .claude/): they steer agents, so one level up from docs
CI config: workflows can read secrets and switch gates off, so one level up from tooling
path names money, value, RepID/scoring, keys/secrets, custody, auth, kill switch, chain/anchor, attestation, grounding or settlement
tooling config that ships nothing: ignore files and jest/test tsconfig
live behaviour: ordinary src/, scripts/, packages/ code or lockfile
